title: Actual alpha compatibility for the fixed support presentation
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a compactification of $f:X\to Y$, coefficient reduction/total-limit calculi $R_W$, an integral compact-support model $M$, and strict Brown comparison data $S,G,H,D$. Use [def-pur-integral-representing-pair-data] and the fixed normalized comparison $\beta$ of [def-pur-integral-support-coordinate-comparison]. For every integral object $K$ on $X$, the reduction of supportPresentation($\beta$), followed by the quotient-coordinate image of the published alpha at $K$, equals the coordinate adjunction counit alpha at $K$ followed by $\beta$ at the coefficient reduction of $K$. This is equality of actual maps in the ordinary derived category of systems.

source.place: Integral Hom display and unit/counit paragraph; coordinate and presentation refinement

proof.text: Expand supportPresentation and the composite adjunction counit. Move beta through the reduction/limit counit by naturality; move the coefficient-model counit through the inverse quotient unit by naturality. Cancel the quotient unit/counit pair using the triangle identity. The coefficient-model counit followed by the actual reduction/limit counit is precisely the published alpha through limitPresentation.

proof_origin.place: Explicit refinement of the integral Hom chain
